verdict.rationale: Asana provides a documented public REST API with authentication, task creation, webhooks, and rule actions (asana-docs-1/2), and probes confirm a live developer docs site with llms.txt and an official MCP server for agentic access (asana-probe-1, asana-probe-3). No OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths, but the documented API surface is clearly present and usable for AI-driven automation.
